verdict.rationale: Automatic payment reminders for overdue customers are explicitly documented ("Avoid late payments with automated payment reminders," "send statement reminders to customers that are late paying you," "Get paid 4 days faster... when you send invoice reminders"), and A/R aging tracking of delinquent accounts is also documented. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of setting up recurring/scheduled invoices, so half the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring invoice scheduling, independent/hands-on confirmation that reminders work as advertised.
